Basic - Establishment charging operational charges without properly disclosing the information on the menu/web/app and the bill/receipt.

sausage gravy (44-47F - Cold Holding)

In cooler less then 4 hours. Moved to rapid chill.
Rechecked, now at 41f.

More information can be found at https://www2.myfloridalicense.com/hotels-restaurants/special-process/. See stop sale.
